_about: The reads run before the ESL merging sheet's paste went to Sam (Rule 10 a: a fresh read, the pending-confirm cross-check). All read-only, through the Supabase MCP.

live_read.transcription: kb/esl_sheet_out/2026-09-26/live_lines.txt, md5 c237f3a478c4152ab8bdca203ae2b66b on the server and here
live_read.scope: every kb_curation row on the 147 identities the paste touches

pending_confirms.query: any merge field other than merge_into whose course_id or value is one of the 147 ids, the 7 survivors, or a current fold target

survivors.meaning: every chain ends at a survivor, so the paste cannot close a cycle

chains.meaning: these identities already hold courses that earlier merges folded into them (June automerges, mostly); flatten_merge_chains in excel_to_dashboard.py carries those courses to the end of the chain, so they follow the identity to its survivor

curator_rows_pointing_in._note: Sam's own June merges (map@rccd.edu). The paste leaves them untouched; all four targets are item 6 re-levels, so his courses move with the identity he merged them into.

rule7.result: the paste is byte-identical with and without the resolution (apply.sql md5 eb665b6134885da29ef4e6a34581ca84)
